description: Service mesh internals decomposed. Envoy as data plane. Istio + Linkerd as control planes. Sidecar injection, traffic management, mTLS, observability. Ambient mesh (sidecar-less). The mechanisms that make service-to-service comms uniform across a fleet.

sub_mechanisms.name: envoy_proxy
sub_mechanisms.definition: L7 proxy. C++. Dynamic configuration via xDS APIs. Sidecar in most service meshes.
sub_mechanisms.why: De facto data plane. Originally Lyft 2016. CNCF graduated. Powers Istio, Consul Connect, AWS App Mesh, Cloudflare. Modular filter chain architecture.

sub_mechanisms.name: xDS_protocols
sub_mechanisms.definition: Envoy's discovery service APIs: LDS (listeners), RDS (routes), CDS (clusters), EDS (endpoints).
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard control-plane → data-plane interface. Lets control plane update Envoy config dynamically. Adopted as standard interface beyond Envoy (e.g., gRPC).

sub_mechanisms.name: sidecar_injection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Webhook on pod create automatically adds sidecar container. Istio's MutatingWebhookConfiguration.
sub_mechanisms.why: Transparent to app. Pods automatically get mesh capabilities. Cost: per-pod CPU + memory overhead. Trade-off vs ambient mesh.

sub_mechanisms.name: istio_control_plane
sub_mechanisms.definition: istiod: combined Pilot (config), Citadel (certs), Galley (validation). Single binary since 1.5.
sub_mechanisms.why: Simplified from earlier multi-component design. Pushes config to Envoy sidecars via xDS. Issues mTLS certificates via SPIFFE.

sub_mechanisms.name: linkerd_rust_proxy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Linkerd 2: Rust-based ultra-light data plane (linkerd2-proxy). Smaller than Envoy.
sub_mechanisms.why: Memory + latency optimised. Trade: fewer features than Envoy. Buoyant focuses on simplicity + ops. CNCF graduated.

sub_mechanisms.name: automatic_mTLS
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mesh issues + rotates certs per service. Sidecars terminate TLS automatically. Zero app code.
sub_mechanisms.why: Zero-trust networking made easy. Without mesh: per-service mTLS code + cert ops. With mesh: just deploy. Major benefit of service mesh.

sub_mechanisms.name: traffic_splitting
sub_mechanisms.definition: Route % of traffic to different versions. 95% v1, 5% v2 for canary.
sub_mechanisms.why: Built into mesh; no app code. Istio VirtualService weighted routes. Combined with monitoring → automated canary analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: fault_injection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Mesh injects failures (delays, aborts) at request level. Chaos engineering via config.
sub_mechanisms.why: Test resilience without code changes. Inject 5% 503s; observe behaviour. Istio VirtualService fault HTTPFault.

sub_mechanisms.name: circuit_breaker_in_mesh
sub_mechanisms.definition: Envoy cluster circuit breaker: max connections, pending requests, retries. Trip when exceeded.
sub_mechanisms.why: Mesh provides natively. No per-service implementation. Configured via xDS. Universal across services.

sub_mechanisms.name: observability_built_in
sub_mechanisms.definition: Every request through sidecar emits metrics + traces + access logs. Free for app developer.
sub_mechanisms.why: RED metrics (Rate/Errors/Duration) per service automatically. Distributed traces with span per hop. Major mesh value-add.

sub_mechanisms.name: ambient_mesh
sub_mechanisms.definition: Istio Ambient: sidecar-less. Per-node proxy (ztunnel) for L4 + per-namespace waypoint for L7.
sub_mechanisms.why: Lower overhead than sidecar per pod. Phased adoption: L4 only first, add L7 waypoint as needed. New approach launched 2022, GA 2024.

sub_mechanisms.name: SPIFFE_SPIRE_identity
sub_mechanisms.definition: SPIFFE: workload identity standard. SPIRE: implementation. spiffe://td/namespace/sa identifiers.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of zero-trust identity. mTLS certs include SPIFFE IDs. Used by Istio + Consul + Tetrate.

derivation_rules.name: service_mesh_centralises_cross_cutting_concerns
if: traffic, security, observability handled by infrastructure
then: app code is simpler + uniform across services
derivation_rules.why: Without mesh: each service implements mTLS, retries, circuit breaking, tracing differently. With: configured once in mesh. Major benefit.

derivation_rules.name: sidecar_overhead_proportional_to_pod_count
then: overhead scales with number of pods
derivation_rules.why: Each Envoy ~50-100 MB RAM, some CPU. 1000 pods = 50-100 GB RAM in sidecars. Ambient mesh reduces by sharing per-node proxy.

derivation_rules.name: ambient_mesh_lower_overhead_at_capability_cost
if: mesh uses ambient (per-node) instead of sidecar (per-pod)
derivation_rules.why: L4 ambient (ztunnel) lightweight. L7 features (HTTP routing, fault injection) require waypoint pod. Trade-off + migration path.

derivation_rules.name: mTLS_via_mesh_eliminates_per_service_TLS_code
derivation_rules.why: Service talks HTTP to localhost sidecar; sidecar terminates / originates TLS. App developer doesn't write TLS code. Zero-trust adoption made easy.

derivation_rules.name: fault_injection_validates_resilience_without_code
then: resilience patterns can be tested in production safely
derivation_rules.why: Chaos engineering via VirtualService config. Inject delays / errors on specific routes. App's retry / fallback exercised. Standard SRE practice.
